primaryAuthority: Oregon State Police Tribal Gaming Section
scopeNotes: Oregon State Police oversees Class III gaming under compacts with Oregon's nine federally recognized tribes. Current state employment/government material identifies nine operating casino locations statewide because the Burns Paiute Tribe's Old Camp Casino closed in 2012 while the Confederated Tribes of Coos, Lower Umpqua and Siuslaw operate two current locations. This staged inventory follows current physical casino destinations rather than historic tribe-by-tribe one-casino assumptions.
